pass.answer: Use a library. A hand-built combobox usually misses focus management, arrow-key navigation and the ARIA combobox pattern. Check Vue's current options in its ecosystem and each library's own docs before you commit; Reka UI and Headless UI's Vue package are candidates to verify.
